title: Goodell on girls' flag football: If you play, you're more likely to be a lifelong fan

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Goodell on girls' flag football: If you play, you're more likely to be a lifelong fan
sources.description: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell says the league's support of girls' flag football is a long-term investment in making football more popular for decades to come.
